annotations.title: Size one apartment building under Fannie Mae, Freddie Mac and HUD loans

description: Runs the multifamily.online comparison app on one 5+ unit building: for Fannie Mae DUS and Small Loans, Freddie Mac Optigo Conventional and Conventional Small, and HUD 223(f), 221(d)(4) and 223(a)(7), returns whether it fits the published limits (or why not), max loan by LTV/LTC and by DSCR, the binding limit, estimated monthly payment incl. HUD MIP, term, and warnings, ranked by max loan. SBA, bank, CMBS, bridge and DSCR loans are listed as ineligible or unpublished.

amortization_years.description: 0 = each program's maximum amortization (the default), or 25, 30 or 35 years for every program.

assisted_pct.description: Percent of units under project-based rental assistance (HAP/Section 8). 90+ gets HUD's assisted limits.

current_balance.description: Current loan balance in dollars (refinance and cash-out).

desired_loan.description: Loan amount you want, in dollars. 0 or omitted = the most each program allows.

fha_insured.description: Whether the current loan is already FHA-insured (needed for HUD 223(a)(7)).

fha_years_left.description: Years left on the FHA-insured loan, for 223(a)(7). Default 25.

gross_rent.description: Gross scheduled rent per year, used only when noi is omitted.

hold_years.description: How long you plan to keep the loan or property, in years. Drives Freddie Mac term choice and prepayment warnings. Default 10.

noi.description: Net operating income in dollars per year (projected stabilized NOI for construction). Omit and give gross_rent + operating_expenses instead to compute it.

operating_expenses.description: Operating expenses per year, used only when noi is omitted.

other_income.description: Other income per year (parking, laundry), used only when noi is omitted.

purpose.description: What the loan is for. construction = new construction or substantial rehab.

rate_pct.description: Optional all-in interest rate in percent. Replaces Treasury + spread when given.

recourse.description: Whether you need a non-recourse loan.

rent_advantage.description: Affordable only: restricted rents sit below market rents (HUD calls this a rent advantage; it gets HUD's affordable limits). Default true.

spread_pct.description: Spread over the Treasury, in percent. Default 1.75 is the site's example, not a quote; lenders do not publish spreads.

stabilized.description: Whether the property is at stabilized occupancy now.

treasury_tenor.description: Treasury tenor the rate is built on: 5, 7 or 10 years. Default 10.

units.description: Number of residential units (5 or more).

vacancy_pct.description: Vacancy and credit loss as a percent of rent plus other income, used only when noi is omitted. Default 5.

value.description: Purchase price (purchase), current value (refinance or cash-out) or total development cost (construction), in dollars.

name: compare_programs
